uxPass1.scope: User, 31 Oct: UI/UX polish with human-like testing ('intuitive, fast, as much relevant information without clutter'). Revises the earlier 'no polish pass' note for the web client only.
uxPass1.method: Coordinator walked Home -> Search -> Compare -> Navigate -> Back -> Settings at 360 x 640 in Hebrew against the real oct31a API (dev proxy), plus the user's own Compare screenshot; findings G1-G11 (shell/Home/Search/Settings), C1-C9 (Compare), N1-N6 (Navigate) went to three parallel Opus agents, each re-testing with screenshots in Hebrew and English for at least two rounds; the coordinator re-walked the merged app.
fixedBugs: sheet stuck at full on Compare/Navigate (unstable setSnap), so the map was never visible
Back from Compare looped on a duplicate Compare entry
'my location' default failed on every plain-HTTP phone (the H-1 preview is HTTP): now starts from the last origin or asks for a start
option rows lacked departure and arrival times
route details were dense text with links to unbuilt screens and no exit times
trains named by their exit stop (rows, details, map)
End trip sat next to Next step
'N stops left' never counted down without call positions
checklist rows hidden under the pinned card and Next button when focused or scrolled to
a 'now' plan stayed frozen at its first timestamp when Compare was shown again
origin truncated to three letters in Compare's one-line header
